question: Does model-A hidden state predict model-B observable forecast, a fixed fusion response, or failure beyond strong input-only controls despite different hidden coordinates?
evidence_class: Exploratory source-held-out predictive/behavioral evidence on previously studied cached data; no cross-model causality, semantic identity or neuron correspondence.

design.evidence: Exploratory source-held-out predictive comparison on previously studied data; not sealed confirmation or causality.
design.split: Use only original FIT sources from both runs. Replication TEST primary; pilot TEST separate sensitivity only. No TEST used to choose settings. Source IDs must be globally disjoint across FIT/TEST.
design.cohorts: Synthetic separately; pooled four-domain natural real separately; injected real separately (artificial contexts, not natural-real evidence). Each real domain TEST has four sources. No domain extrapolation claim.
design.features: Full original token flattening at last saved cut: Bolt block3 9x512, TimesFM block10 4x1280. Same 128-step context; no token/window pseudo-replication. Fixed role-depth, not homologous layers or actual head-input ceiling.
design.input: 128 z-scored past values, 65 FFT magnitudes, ACF lags1..32, 9 quantiles, context mean/SD and log SD, saved past-only decomposition tone descriptors. FIT standardized. Untruncated full-history ridge and full-descriptor ridge, PCA8/16, or RBF gamma .5/2 divided by FIT median squared distance.
design.normalization: Both input and hidden probes predict identical normalized targets. Forecast inverse is history_mean + history_SD * predicted_normalized_forecast for every arm; response inverse is history_SD * predicted_normalized_response. Log failure uses normalized MSE, flag compares native/persistence on the same row. No hidden-only arm is asked to recover physical scale/offset omitted by native normalization.
design.fitting: Weighted FIT-only dual PCA rank8/16 capped at training source count minus1, preserving orthogonal geometry with one scalar normalization. Four domain-stratified source folds choose kernel and ridge alpha .001/.01/.1/1 independently per endpoint/arm; then refit all FIT. Each source equal total weight.

endpoint_definitions.forecast: 32-step B native forecast centered by past mean and scaled by past SD
endpoint_definitions.fusion_response: B saved depth1, first-cut, equal-weight, blend1 fusion minus B native, divided by past SD. If tree abstains, response exactly0; no TEST selection.
endpoint_definitions.log_failure: log1p(mean squared B-native error / past variance)
endpoint_definitions.failure_flag: B native MSE exceeds last-value persistence MSE; ridge probability clipped[0,1], Brier loss

design.same_model: B hidden is a same-capacity empirical comparator, not a guaranteed upper bound; sampled layer does not include whole decoder.
design.controls: 19 uniform FIT source-block hidden permutations within cohort/domain/case signature, TEST unchanged; refit PCA and reselect ridge for every permutation. Orthogonal Householder rotations of actual full-token hidden features must preserve Gram/probe predictions. General nonorthogonal transforms need not preserve PCA/ridge regularization.
design.uncertainty: Mean row loss within source then equal source mean. Paired 4000 source-bootstrap draws, frozen predictions; 95% exploratory intervals and 98.75% Bonferroni intervals for four synthetic primary contrasts. No training-set or new-domain uncertainty.
design.primary: Synthetic replication TEST: both directions x forecast/log_failure, input+A_hidden vs input. All other endpoints/cohorts descriptive. 19 null draws give coarse minimum tail rank .05; no formal permutation p-value claim.
design.promotion: Recommend targeted new-data expansion only if a synthetic primary contrast has >=5% lower loss, 98.75% gain interval lower>0, exceeds all19 shuffled alignment gains, passes actual-state rotation, and same-model input+B_hidden improves over input. Otherwise no broad expansion; negative result is recipe/power bounded.
limitations: Prior data/results inspected historically; frozen protocol does not restore unseen-data status.
Real4/domain and unknown pretraining overlap; synthetic generator families narrow and related.
Failure prediction is supervised target-risk estimation; future labels only enter FIT fitting and TEST scoring.
Hidden states are deterministic input transforms; incremental value depends on baseline and probe class, not information-theoretic independence.
No raw cross-model L2, neuron matching, causal mediation, or mechanistic identity claim.
No layer/PCA/hyperparameter changes after inspecting TEST.

distillation: Synthetic cross-hidden augmentation improves native-forecast emulation in both directions: Bolt->TimesFM relative loss reduction0.34100894721653885; TimesFM->Bolt0.16452879818918864. Both pass the frozen four-contrast expansion screen.
Input+Aforecast has lower forecast-emulation loss than input+Ahidden in both directions. Hidden-state usefulness beyond the other model forecast has NOT been tested in this pilot.

TimesFM->Bolt synthetic fixed fusion-response gain0.00032344 (rounded here; exact in exact_findings) is a descriptive positive, not a registered primary claim or evidence of shared component semantics.

TimesFM->Bolt synthetic log-failure loss improves44.13835076148873%, but one source-shuffled hidden alignment improves slightly more (tail rank0.10). It fails the full screen. Bolt->TimesFM log-failure does not improve.
Natural-real forecast emulation gets worse in both directions; natural-real failure signals are mixed and fail alignment-null screening. Each domain has only4 TEST sources.
Failure flags have no TEST positives for synthetic TimesFM, either natural-real model, and injected-real TimesFM. Zero Brier loss there is uninformative about failure detection.

Different coordinate systems do not prevent useful supervised cross-model observable prediction. This does not establish independent information beyond inputs, mechanism correspondence, interpretable features, or causal mediation.

test_validation.plants: Known linear shared signal and independent decoy; deleted signal, broken rotation, row split, TEST-fit leakage, row bootstrap, coordinate-scaling and unstable CV ties explicitly rejected in tests.

initial_validation.plants: Known linear shared signal and independent decoy; deleted signal, broken rotation, row split, TEST-fit leakage, row bootstrap and coordinate-scaling regressions explicitly rejected in tests.

controls.normalization: Every arm predicts the same history-normalized B forecast/response with identical history-only physical inverse. No hidden-only physical-scale disadvantage.
controls.input_baseline: Untruncated full-history ridge and full-descriptor ridge plus PCA/RBF candidates; only FIT group CV chooses. Synthetic forecast selects RBF; natural-real forecasts select full-history ridge.
controls.source_dependence: FIT/TEST disjoint whole sources, group inner CV, equal source weighting and source bootstrap; repeated conditions are not independent n.

failed_instrumentation_runs.status: aborted on actual-state rotation before publishing or interpreting TEST risks
failed_instrumentation_runs.diagnosis: Initial actual-state real_natural Bolt->TimesFM log_failure selected pca16+pca8 before rotation and descriptor_ridge+pca8 after. CV losses differed at roundoff1e-17 while final predictions differed0.054029673. CV folds with <=16 rank can tie full and truncated input kernels, while final FIT has20 sources so truncation changes the final model. This is numerical instability of model selection, not substantive fixed-candidate coordinate sensitivity.

amendment.reason: Actual-state orthogonal rotation gate failed before publishing/interpreting TEST losses: real_natural Bolt-to-TimesFM log_failure CV choices pca16+pca8 vs descriptor_ridge+pca8 tied at ~0.0347558984261798; 1e-17 CV roundoff changed final candidate and predictions by0.054029673. Fixed-candidate kernels agreed within4.92e-14.
amendment.change: Choose first declared candidate within 1e-12*max(1,abs(minimum CV loss)) of minimum. No target, baseline, rank, alpha, split, null, bootstrap or promotion-rule changes.
amendment.outcome_status: Only choices and rotation discrepancies inspected; no TEST risk interpreted. Earlier in-memory results discarded. Original analysis.log retained.

failed_instrumentation_runs.classification: Floating-point CV winner instability; fixed-candidate preprocessing/PCA/ridge is rotation invariant to numerical precision. Not TSFM semantic disagreement.

limitations: Prior data/results inspected historically; frozen protocol does not restore unseen-data status.
Real4/domain and unknown pretraining overlap; synthetic generator families narrow and related.
Failure prediction is supervised target-risk estimation; future labels only enter FIT fitting and TEST scoring.
Hidden states are deterministic input transforms; incremental value depends on baseline and probe class, not information-theoretic independence.
No raw cross-model L2, neuron matching, causal mediation, or mechanistic identity claim.
No layer/PCA/hyperparameter changes after inspecting TEST.
Bootstrap omits training-set and domain-level uncertainty.19 null draws yield coarse ranks, not confirmatory p-values.

No input+Aforecast+Ahidden baseline was preregistered or measured in this pilot.
